name: Rollin' Justin
summary: A two-armed humanoid upper body on a four-wheeled, variable-width base, built by DLR for research into sensitive two-handed manipulation. Justin has compliant lightweight arms and four-finger hands, and has been used in telepresence experiments where astronauts on the ISS commanded it to service equipment on the ground.
notable: Commanded from orbit in DLR/ESA telerobotics experiments
